description: It was an honor to stand with Lieutenant Governor Davis and fellow candidates Sean Steeg for State Senate, Caleb McCoy for PA House79, and Sarah Holland for PA House 80, as well as with newly-elected Blair County Democratic Committee Chair McCailey Flaugh last Sunday in Duncansville, Blair County. Lieutenant Governor Davis introduced his beautiful family…
